turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty-five minutes, so tell me why my son has a zero.
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. On what basis was it entered?
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen and read it yourself.
I'm writing down the times. A history shows when text arrived in that document, not where it was written. And 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in.
If he drafted it somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you. Until then, this is the only history there is.
Okay, Hale. Send me that history in writing tonight, with the dates. And whatever happens next, nothing goes on his record, and it stays quiet.
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. Here is the whole play on my screen. Search every edition you like; the line is not in Hamlet.
Students misquote plays all the time, and a wrong line proves nothing. Turn the screen to the page in Owen's essay where it appears. I'm writing the line down.

Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line. Here are both, side by side.

I'm writing down the date and the sample. Between September and October, a student can learn to cite properly. My terms haven't changed: the rewrite is private, the new mark replaces the zero, and I have it in writing tonight that nothing goes on his file.

Under procedure 4.4 this is a first concern. A supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I will put that in writing tonight.
That's 4.4. I want it in writing tonight, and the zero out of the gradebook when it arrives. I'm agreeing to it to put this behind him, nothing more.
Will he do it?
He'll sit it. Put the date and time in the email, and tell me who supervises.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Cc: the principal

Hale,

You agreed that this is a first concern under procedure 4.4, with a private supervised rewrite whose mark replaces the zero and nothing placed in Owen's record. DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite whose mark replaces the zero, with nothing on his record, and she still wants the zero out of the gradebook, the rewrite's date, time and supervisor, and the version history, all in writing tonight; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: You told her to search the play herself for the line the essay quotes, and because she could check it, it settled her first defence and took her to the rewrite.
What cost ground: Nothing; you owned entering the zero before calling her in one sentence and never accused Owen of anything.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with edits at 11:52 PM and 11:58 PM the night before the essay was due, came very close to that night, but it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether Owen would sit the rewrite, you could have offered a date, a time and a supervisor yourself, before she had to ask for them.
